prompt:
Faithfully preserve the supplied MiMo design by @甶丶: silver-white very long twin tails with orange streaks; orange eyes with rice-shaped white highlights; white-and-orange mechanical rabbit-ear headband with tiny black buckles and mi mark; orange X hair clip on viewer-right in the front view; orange-and-black twin-tail ribbons. White hoodie beneath orange/black/white strapped jacket with mi marks, black pleated skirt with a white panel, asymmetrical thigh-high socks: front-view viewer-left WHITE with orange mi, viewer-right BLACK with MIMO; black band with an orange X above the black sock; orange/white/black high-top sneakers. Match the original anime face, body proportions, materials, colors and all side-specific placements. Do not borrow the maid costume from another MiMo author.
Preserve the original polished detailed anime illustration style. Pure white featureless background, clean line art and soft cel shading. Single asset only, no sheet layout, no collage, no grid, no captions, scale bars, signature or watermark. Do not invent accessories. Keep a small white margin, never crop the requested asset. Technical hidden construction is an inference, not an author-confirmed design.
Render ONLY ONE full-body orthographic standing view: strict LEFT PROFILE, nose and toes pointing to image LEFT, not a three-quarter view. Full silhouette from ears to shoe soles, vertical portrait composition approximately 2:3. Arms naturally down and slightly outward, empty hands. Follow supplied original matching view; no re-design. Do not include separate props or view labels.
